commentary_segments.text_raw:
Coupling is best visible
when a sinusoidal waveform
is analyzed with high
spectral purity. Switching
on the logic functions on the
same substrate, induces
high-frequency noise on the
waveform. This is a result of
coupling. It deteriorates
drastically the SNR. This is
what has to be avoided in
present-day mixed-signal
circuits.
commentary_segments.text: Coupling is best visible when a sinusoidal waveform is analyzed with high spectral purity. Switching on the logic functions on the same substrate, induces high-frequency noise on the waveform. This is a result of coupling. It deteriorates drastically the SNR. This is what has to be avoided in present-day mixed-signal circuits.
